en: Data management is the development, execution and supervision of plans, policies, programs, and practices that deliver, control, protect, and enhance the value of data and information assets throughout their lifecycle.

Important areas of data management: data governance, data modeling and design, data lineage, storage and optimization, data integration and interoperability, data lifecycle management, ethics and privacy.
The key components of DataOps are automation, observability and monitoring, and incident response.
Key components of orchestration: time or event-based, efficient task management, automated error handling, scalability, monitoring and alerting, Directed Acyclic Graph, aka DAG.
